title: Sharks and rays as a share of the fish landed at Fiume, 1914–1923
description: Bar chart. Sharks and rays as a percentage, by weight, of all fish landed at the Fiume (Rijeka) market: 7.4 in 1914, 5.8 in 1915, 10.5 in 1916, 13.8 in 1917, 18.7 in 1918, 8.2 in 1919, 6.9 in 1920, 5.8 in 1921, 7.5 in 1922, 6.3 in 1923. Computed from D'Ancona's 1926 market figures as digitized by OGS and ISPRA (2017).
heading: SHARKS AND RAYS · % OF FISH LANDED AT FIUME, BY WEIGHT

source.container: Historical landings from the Rijeka (Croatia) fish market between 1914 and 1932, OGS and ISPRA, after D'Ancona 1926
